legend: Templates for this problem are available here.
Alice is standing at position 1%%ZSMJ0%% of a straight road and wants to reach position n%%ZSMJ1%%. Initially, she has 0%%ZSMJ2%% stamina. On each day, she can do exactly one of the following:
Walk forward from position i%%ZSMJ3%% to position i+1%%ZSMJ4%% and lose 1%%ZSMJ5%% stamina. She can only do this if she has at least 1%%ZSMJ6%% stamina.
Rest at her current position i%%ZSMJ7%% and gain ai%%ZSMJ8%% stamina.
input: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases t%%ZSMJ10%% (1≤t≤104%%ZSMJ11%%). The description of the test cases follows.
The first line of each test case contains an integer n%%ZSMJ12%% (2≤n≤2⋅105%%ZSMJ13%%) — the number of positions on the road.
The second line of each test case contains n%%ZSMJ14%% integers a1,…,an%%ZSMJ15%% (1≤ai≤109%%ZSMJ16%%) — the amount of stamina Alice gains by resting at position i%%ZSMJ17%%.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n%%ZSMJ18%% over all test cases does not exceed 2⋅105%%ZSMJ19%%.
output: For each test case, output one integer — the minimum number of days Alice needs to reach position n%%ZSMJ20%%.
note: In the first test case, Alice can rest at position 1%%ZSMJ21%% for the first 3%%ZSMJ22%% days and walk forward for the next 3%%ZSMJ23%% days.
In the second test case, Alice can do the following:
Rest at position 1%%ZSMJ24%%. After this, her stamina is 1%%ZSMJ25%%.
Walk to position 2%%ZSMJ26%%. After this, her stamina is 0%%ZSMJ27%%.
Rest at position 2%%ZSMJ28%%. After this, her stamina is 2%%ZSMJ29%%.
Walk to position 3%%ZSMJ30%%. After this, her stamina is 1%%ZSMJ31%%.
Walk to position 4%%ZSMJ32%%. After this, her stamina is 0%%ZSMJ33%%.
